meta.name: Always Funny Videos
meta.description:
The Always Funny Videos Channel is family-friendly comedy for all from the creators of AFV! America's Funniest Home Videos brings you the best home videos and family-friendly comedy programming you can watch together with everyone in your family!

Shows: World's Funniest Videos: Top 10 Countdown, World's Funniest Videos Top 10 Countdown, The Funny Files, America's Funniest Home Videos, Totally Funny Animals
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, The Roku Channel
